justification: Secure flag is configuration-driven: SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=auto sets it in production, and public/index.php refuses to start in production without secure cookies. It stays off only for local HTTP (Docker on localhost:8080), where a secure cookie would never be sent and login would fail.
Since PHP 7.2 session_write_close() returns bool (true on success). The project targets PHP 8.2+, so checking the result is correct and reports a failed session write.
